notes._about: Shared canvas cases (spec/canvas/canvas.md). Every port reads this file. Times in ms unless a field says sec. Ids are placeholders.
notes.frames: Grids are 32 x 18 grey values (0..255), row by row. A frame is written as {"flat": v} (every cell v), {"texture": seed, "bars": [left, top, right, bottom] cells, "barValue": v} (cell = barValue inside a bar, else 60 + (x*37 + y*11 + seed*53) % 120, the phone ClipJudgeTest frame), or {"cols": [32 values]} (each column one value on every row). A timed list is {"everyMs": n, "runs": [[count, frame], ...]} (frame i at i*everyMs) or {"fps30": true, "runs": ...} (frame i at floor(i*1000/30)).
notes.cache: canvas.md §2. Phone CanvasCache.java:56-93, AnimatedCover.java:438,455-456,469,522; BitChord CanvasRepository.kt:159-160.
notes.appleScore: canvas.md §3. BitChord AppleMusicCanvas.kt:178-233 (score), 82-107 (ranking), CanvasArtwork.kt:73-94 (normalizeForMatch, splitArtists). score null = rejected outright; taken = score >= 12 and the hit has motion art.
notes.spotifyMatch: canvas.md §4. Metrolist DirectCanvasProvider.kt:397-436. Durations in ms; 0 or null = unknown.
notes.spotifyTotp: canvas.md §4. spotlib TOTP as SpotifyCanvas.java:257-272: the secret xor (i % 33 + 9) joined as decimal digits (spotlib Totp.kt joinToString), HMAC-SHA1, 30 s steps, 6 digits.
notes.spotifyCanvas: canvas.md §4 rule 5. Metrolist 460a3168a DirectCanvasProvider.kt:224-237 (spotifyTrackCanvas). answer: the pathfinder JSON for operationName canvas; expect the canvas URL, or null.
notes.videoMatch: canvas.md §5. Prism MusicVideoMatch.kt:19-58 (pick). The song, the search results in order; expect the picked id or null.
notes.bestPart: canvas.md §6. Prism BestPart.kt:68-101 (peakMs). intensity = one value per segment of segmentMs; expect startMs or null (nothing stands out). noFrames: FrameJudge.kt:72-76.
notes.clipJudge: canvas.md §7. Prism FrameJudge.kt (bars 97-112, isStill 130-140, windows 149-177, choose 203-210, cropX 232-257, judge 59-69) and ClipRefine.kt (cuts 79-91, flashing 94-117, end 123-126, the flash loop 195-198).
notes.display: canvas.md §8. Phone AnimatedCover.java:170-174 (tallClip), 190-201 (letterboxZoom); BitChord NowPlayingScreen.kt:1548-1550 (clip fade).
notes.backdrop: canvas.md §9-10. Metrolist FullscreenArtworkBleed.kt:120-127, 156-163, 341, 408-411; BitChord ArtworkMeshBackdrop.kt:747-755 (lifted). The bleed cases (blurRadius, bleedRows, coverZoom, stripRows) are phone-only: the bleed is blended onto YouTube's own art, so a player that draws its own backdrop (BitChord's mesh) marks them not applicable.
notes.badge: canvas.md §11. BitChord PlayerControls.kt:1911-1913 (band), PlayerChrome.kt:24-33 (chrome alphas; chromeWhite is BitChord's PlayerChrome rule, §11.2).
notes.settings: canvas.md §13. Metrolist AnimatedCoverSelection.kt:28-39 (parseOrder, parseEnabled; our ids video, spotify, apple), SettingsFeatureControls.kt:168-171 (all off stored as NONE), AnimatedArtworkService.kt:1195-1245, 1276-1282 (variant pick; cap null = Original). A variant is [width, height, bandwidth]; expect its index.
